text:
All tests pass now.

**Root cause:** `RetryError.reraise()` only unwrapped `TryAgain` when it had an explicit `__cause__` (i.e. `raise TryAgain from err`). A plain `raise TryAgain` inside an `except` block sets the implicit `__context__` (not `__cause__`), so that path fell through and the opaque `TryAgain` sentinel was reraised, losing the original `UpstreamError`.

**Fix:** In `tenacity/__init__.py`, when `TryAgain.__cause__` is `None`, also check `TryAgain.__context__` (unless exception chaining was explicitly suppressed via `raise ... from None`) and unwrap that instead. This restores the original behavior of surfacing the underlying exception from an implicit `except`-block `raise TryAgain`, while still respecting explicit `from err`/`from None` chaining.
